data_quality.note: week_central ships a per-TEAM placeholder row alongside each parsed game, so every fixture appears two or three times and the two kinds disagree on the score. One row per fixture is kept, parsed preferred. Routes that name neither team are dropped rather than followed.

derivation.real: Scores, margins, dates, statuses and team ids are measured — from week_central.
derivation.derived: The success edge is PROJECTED from both teams' season profiles (offense vs opponent defense), because per-game success rate does not exist in this season's export. It says whether the matchup should have been close, not whether a team moved the ball that night.
derivation.pass_note: Only rushing has a true success rate in this export. Pass efficiency (completion + explosive) is folded in at half weight until a pass success rate ships.
